description: Ruby's own File.fnmatch(pattern, string, File::FNM_PATHNAME), the reading GitHub documents for ruleset ref patterns, as [pattern, string, matches]. Recorded 2026-10-29 with /usr/bin/ruby 2.6.10p210 on macOS from random patterns over literal, star, double star, question mark, slash, escape and set tokens (sets with ranges, reversed ranges, leading and trailing hyphens, negation, empty and unclosed sets), half of them with strings built from their patterns so that many match; it includes the leading-hyphen set from AC-51-v1's round-1 Acceptance. The owner script's `fnmatch` agreed with about 138,000 such pairs; it must agree with every row here.
